$comment: Accepted dependency advisories. Enforced by scripts/check-dependency-audit.mjs (npm, CI job deps-audit) and scripts/check-pip-audit.py (pip, CI job deps-audit-python). Each entry needs ecosystem (npm|pip, default npm), id (GHSA/CVE), package, reason, expires (ISO date). Prefer fixing; an entry here is a decision, not a workaround.
